messages:
maria: Heads-up — trying to onboard neptune-7b-lite to staging. weights are at s3://redwood-models/neptune/7b-lite/v1.0. tokenizer uses an extra special token (id=2) for <SEP> which breaks our pad-truncation in the loader. can someone sanity-check config + container deps?
kevin: on it. which runtime image are you pointing at? cudA/Triton mismatch is usually the culprit.
maria: currently `redwood/runtime:cuda12.4-triton23` per the onboarding doc. CI failed when I ran local smoke: OOM during kernel selection and then triton fallback error.
devon: dump the exact error? sometimes the kernel selector tries mixed-precision kernels that aren't built for sm_86.
maria: paste from CI log: ```
[2026-06-12T09:02:11Z] kernel_launcher.cc:213] KernelSelectionError: couldn't find kernel for op attention_cuda (requested compute 86, available: 80,75)
[2026-06-12T09:02:11Z] triton_client.cc:88] TRITON_ERROR: incompatible backend for model 'neptune_7b_lite'
```
kevin: yup looks like the container image doesn't have kernels for sm_86. Are we running on g5?
maria: staging nodes are g5.2xlarge (sm_86).
devon: quick fix: pin kernel set to include sm_86 in the kernel build list or use `redwood/runtime:cuda12.5-triton24-kernels-sm86` (we have a prebuilt variant).
kevin: note: cuda12.5 image pulls in libcudnn version X which required a small change in the `cublas` loader. I'll open a tiny patch to add the loader fallback.
ci-bot: Build #4928 failed - see https://ci.internal/redwood/runtime/4928 for logs :rotating_light:
maria: thanks. also the tokenizer oddness — when I run fasttext tokenizer conversion I got token_ids shifting by +1. probably because of reserved BOS/UNK mapping in HF config. quick check: config.json contains `add_special_tokens: true`?
devon: check `tokenizer.json` field `special_tokens_map`. If <SEP> isn't listed, the serialization can shift ids. We had that w/ zephyr-lite last month.
kevin: I'll add a preflight to the onboarding script to validate `vocab_size` vs highest token id in the vocab and fail early with a clear message.
maria: awesome. can one of you trigger a container rebuild with the sm_86 kernels and the loader patch? I can re-run the tokenizer conversion after that.
kevin: I'll queue a rebuild now, tagging it `neptune-onboard-sm86-196452`. pinging @ops-bot for capacity.
ops-bot: Received rebuild request. Queued on build node build-08. ETA ~12m.
ci-bot: Build #4930 started. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/runtime/4930
kevin: also leaving a TODO in the PR: (1) add kernel matrix test for sm_75/86/90, (2) add tokenizer preflight, (3) document S3 layout for neptune.
maria: perfect. will rerun smoke after #4930 passes. thanks y'all :pray:
